items.q: And there was also a saxophonist by the name of Charles Price, known as C. Q. Price.

ctx.x: player, still is. And in fact he was one of the most excellent trombone players I've ever heard in my life, and still is -- I consider him to be one of the greatest trombone players in the world.
And there was also a saxophonist by the name of Charles Price, known as C. Q. Price.
